Blackstone Valley NEMBA Dam Nice Ride (West Hill Dam)

Uxbridge, MA · Mountain bike

Blackstone Valley NEMBA Dam Nice Ride (West Hill Dam) is a mountain bike group ride in Uxbridge, MA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:30 am from West Hill Dam, Rice City parking.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Blackstone Valley NEMBA Dam Nice Ride (West Hill Dam) group ride

A Sunday-morning mountain bike ride at West Hill Dam, an Army Corps of Engineers reserve with trails for beginner to intermediate riders and a pump track.
